title: Numerousness
summary: NU'MEROUSNESS, noun 1. The quality of being numerous or many; the quality of consisting of a great number of individuals; as the numerousness of an army or of an assembly. 2. The quality of consisting

inlines.v: NU'MEROUSNESS, noun 1. The quality of being numerous or many; the quality of consisting of a great number of individuals; as the numerousness of an army or of an assembly. 2. The quality of consisting of poetic numbers; melodiousness; musicalness.
